fact: On 31 March 2021 the security ministry reported that ten police and gendarmerie units of Greater Conakry had been equipped with SIPAO material (from an EU gift through INTERPOL of 40 computers, 40 routers, 40 scanners and two servers), that 44 officers had been trained, that a budget line for the programme was in the ministry's 2021 budget, and that the database is to allow all procès-verbaux drawn up in the services to be digitised.
title: 5ème réunion du SIPAO : Damantang Albert rassure les membres du comité de pilotage
